body.condition: There is a constant \(\underline q>0\) such that, for every \(c\in\mathcal C\), \(\inf_x\inf_{0\le t\le\max_\ell t_{c\ell}}Q_c(t\mid x)\ge\underline q\), and, jointly over the fixed cells and folds, \(\inf_x\inf_{0\le t\le\max_\ell t_{c\ell}}\widehat Q_{c,-f}(t\mid x)\ge\underline q/2\) with probability tending to one.

novel.justification: Provisional faithful score-domain refinement pending orchestrator and D0.5 approval: it records the positive event-survival tail already needed to make the displayed score and survival-ratio cancellation defined; it does not supply the orthogonality or product-rate crux.
